name: MapText
description: This archive contains the complete source tree used in the study "MapTextOCR: An end-to-end framework for Chinese character recognition in digital maps via spatial attention and visual-semantic collaborative error correction". Contents -------- - code/mapdata/ procedural renderer that synthesises the MapText benchmark from vector base maps; no third-party map imagery is redistributed - code/models/ MapTextRecognizer (ResNet backbone + spatial attention module + BiLSTM + CTC) and the visual-semantic error corrector (character n-gram model, confusion table, multi-head attention, adaptive iteration) - code/train.py training entry point (fixed-width batching, --resume, --max-hours) - code/evaluate.py evaluation with CA / SA / ED, per interference level L1-L4 - code/baselines/ external-engine baselines (PP-OCRv3 via RapidOCR, EasyOCR) and their scoring scripts - code/tools/ scripts that turn raw results into the manuscript tables and figures, tau selection on the validation split, archive packers - code/results/ measured results backing every number reported in the paper Reproducing the paper --------------------- The archive is self-contained.
